questions.q: What does segment value security restrict that ledger-level data access alone does not?
options: Whether a user can log in at all
Which currency a journal can use
Access to specific values of a chart-of-accounts segment (such as legal entity or division), even within a ledger the user otherwise has access to
Whether Create Accounting can run
questions.explain: Segment value security is a finer-grained restriction than ledger-level access — it can block specific segment values (e.g., one division) even when the user has access to the ledger overall.

questions.q: What was the first diagnostic step taken in this ticket, and why?
options: Checking whether other Fixtures Division controllers had the same restriction, to determine if this was a pattern rather than a single misconfigured user
Immediately granting the controller access to Structural Division
Deleting the controller's data role
Closing the ticket without investigation
questions.explain: Checking whether the restriction was consistent across similar users (other Fixtures Division controllers) helped determine this was intentional rather than a one-off misconfiguration.

questions.q: What did checking the controller's ledger-level data role show?
options: It was missing entirely
It only included Structural Division
It had no assigned security profile at all
It included the full ledger (both divisions), ruling out a Lesson 24-style business unit/ledger access gap
questions.explain: Since the data role covered the full ledger (both divisions), the restriction had to be coming from a different layer — segment value security — rather than a business unit/ledger gap.

questions.q: What was the actual root cause of the controller being unable to see Structural Division journals?
options: A misconfigured data role unique to this controller
A deliberately configured segment value security rule restricting Fixtures Division controllers to the Fixtures Division segment value
A closed accounting period
A failed Journal Import
questions.explain: The restriction was confirmed as an intentional segment value security rule, consistently applied across all Fixtures Division controllers.

questions.q: What was the correct resolution for this ticket?
options: Immediately remove the segment value security rule
Grant the controller a system administrator role
Explain that the restriction is intentional and consistent, and route any genuine business need for broader access as a deliberate access request
Disable segment value security for the entire ledger
questions.explain: Since the restriction was working as designed, the correct response was confirmation and explanation rather than a correction, with any real access need routed through proper channels.
